issues.description: Method signature mismatch for messageOnMilk: the Problem Statement (task description) requires messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) (i.e., a method with a double parameter and expected return string including the volume), but the template usage and the solution define and call a no-argument method messageOnMilk() returning String (and implementations in Goat and Seal implement no-arg messageOnMilk()). This contradiction between the textual requirement and the provided/template code will confuse students about which signature to implement and may cause compilation/test mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the specification and the code. Preferred (minimal disruption): update problem_statement.md to require messageOnMilk() without parameters and specify the expected return format (e.g., "[Animal Type] [name] is milked") to match the template and solution. Alternatively, if the intent was to include milk volume, change the Milkable interface and all implementations and call sites (Main, any tests) to messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) and update return strings and examples to include the volume.
